name: New Infusionsoft Order to Xero Invoice
description:
Recipe Title : **Sync new Infusionsoft invoices and lines with Xero**


---------------------------------------
**Important Notes : **  

### Please Read through this Description before starting the recipe. 
---------------------------------------


### What this recipe Does :

Advanced recipe: Creates a new Xero Invoice for any new Infusionsoft Order Created.

- There is an additional wait time of 5 minutes (excluding polling cycle) to allow for your Order Line Items to be created when the order is created.
- If the Infusionsoft Order has no Line Items, it will not create any Invoice in Xero
- No duplicates are created, and no updates are made to existing invoice.
- Voided Xero Invoice that were synced from Infusionsoft will not be picked up.
- The Infusionsoft Invoice Number will be stored in the Xero Reference field

_Contact Syncing_
Contact is created if it does not exist in your Xero.
- Contact is created based on the provided format that you'd prefer for First Name, Last Name, and Company Name. Please see Configuration Parameter for more details.
- If the Order's Contact DOES NOT have EITHER First Name, Last Name, AND Company Name, The Order will not be synced, and you will be notified on your Job Report as well as Email Notification.

_Item Syncing_
Items are created based on the products associated with each Order Line Items.
- If the Item does not exist in your QuickBooks, one will be created.
- Items are matched based on Product Name as the Item Name.
- Taxes are computed by Xero based on the Item tax codes. 



-----------------------------------
### Parameters

	- Parameters are configurations available to provide a level of customisations for essential components such as Taxes and Currencies.
	        Note : Make sure that all parameters are set correctly BEFORE starting the recipe. It will affect the behaviour of your recipes. 

- Currency code: Currency code to assign to the Xero Invoice
- Invoice Status: Status the created Xero invoice will be set to
- Account Code: Default Account code to be assigned to items created in Xero
- Item Code Choice : Choose how would you like to represent your Xero Item when created. Note that Item Codes in Xero is limited to 30 characters only.
- Client name format : Allows you to display your invoice in Xero in the specified format. You can choose permutations for combinations of First Name, Last Name, and Company.
- Additional Wait Time : Additional Wait time allows you to hold on to your orders to give you extra time to add in your order items before it is being processed by Workato. 
- Invoice Amounts are : Specify if your Xero invoices line amount are tax inclusive, tax exclusive, or tax should not be applied at all. Note that this parameter will affect how Xero calculates your invoice line item amounts
- Tax Types : Specify the tax that you would want to apply to items in your Xero invoice.

----------------------------------
Support
For all enquiries, troubleshooting, and recipe behaviour related questions, please post them here : https://support.workato.com/support/discussions

Learn more about Workato 
https://support.workato.com/support/solutions

Change Log : 
16 Aug 2016  
- DELETED invoices in Xero will now not be synced.
- Added new parameters for Tax inclusivity and Choose Tax Types. For taxable invoices, please notify if line amounts are tax inclusive, exclusive, or no tax. Xero will then calculate them.
   - Non taxable items will not be affected by your choice in Tax Types, but taxable items will apply the specified tax

11 Oct 2016
  - Added SKU fail safe. If products do not have SKU the job should not fail.

6 Sept 2016
 - Fixed Invoice Dates to use Due date when Date created is not present
 - Tax type parameter can now be specified on your own. Please make sure that the specified tax type name exist in your Xero system.
 - Added Email notifications when creating new item in Xero
 - Fixed Item code issue when creating invoice in Xero.

28 Sept 2016
 - Allow Authorized invoice creation to be added with line items. 
- Fix invoice creation where account code was using the default account code and not item account code.
